text:
seema: quick sketch — thinking about snapshot-based rollback/rollforward for runtime configs. WIP idea, want a quick gut-check.
liam: love this. main goals? fast preview, safe partial restores, auditable ids.
seema: exactly. also needs to play nicely with console dry-preview and canary cohorts.
jong: (typo) jon: +1 the canary bit. also want explicit merge vs replace semantics.
liam: rough API idea:
```
POST /v1/configs/snapshots
body: { "source_config_id": "cfg-abc", "note": "pre-rollout snapshot" }
-> 201 { "snapshot_id": "sn-20250315-0001" }
\nPOST /v1/configs/snapshots/sn-20250315-0001/apply
body: { "target": "prod", "mode": "patch|replace", "cohort": "10%:beta-users" }
```
ophelia: UI: show "preview as-of snapshot" with diffs per-route + estimated affected qps. small mockup: side-by-side JSON + highlighted keys.
miguel: telemetry hooks: emit snapshot.diff.metrics (num_keys_changed, routes_impacted) + telemetry sampling tag snapshot_id. helps rollbacks.
seema: ops questions: 1) snapshot size - cap at 5MB? 2) secrets handling — snapshots must redact secrets and store pointers to KMS-wrapped blobs.
liam: agree cap. for secrets: snapshot metadata includes `secret_refs: ["kms://..."]` and restore will error unless caller has KMS decrypt right.
jon: rollback semantics: prefer 2 flavors: 
- rollforward (apply patch on top of current, fast)
- time-travel (reset to exact snapshot state, destructive)
ops team needs an explicit confirm for time-travel.
ophelia: good UX: default to rollforward; show diff and checkbox "force exact restore (destructive)" with extra confirmation modal.
miguel: add immutable snapshot id + ledger entry for audit. also TTL/retention policy per org: default 30d, opt-in long-retain for enterprise.
seema: automation: allow snapshots as part of CI pre-rollout: `redwoodctl snapshot create --config cfg-abc --note pre-canary` then `redwoodctl snapshot apply --id sn-... --cohort 5%`.
liam: edge case: concurrent config changes after snapshot creation. Suggest apply API accept `base_config_version` and fail if divergence unless `force=true`.
jon: also need a dry-run endpoint that simulates outcome and returns `predicted_impact` + sample traces.
seema: telemetry contract for dry-run: emit `dryrun.snapshot_id` and include `predicted_error_rate_delta`. ops can subscribe.
miguel: emergency path: snapshot rollback must be callable from CLI + console with RBAC. if API fails, fallback to `apply-on-fallback` route that routes traffic to safe default model.
ophelia: UI detail: show a small histogram of users exposed during canary over time and a link to drill into user cohorts.
liam: security: snapshots should not embed secrets in plain. also encrypt at rest and sign snapshots for tamper detection.
seema: nice. open questions: where do we store snapshots? s3 with encryption + ledger DB? will need lifecycle worker to GC expired snaps.
miguel: yep. retention policy + soft-delete window (24h) before permanent GC.
jon: tests: add e2e that creates snapshot, applies patch to 10% cohort, verifies metrics, then reverts. include simulated concurrent edit test.
seema: follow-up action items:
- liam: draft API PR for snapshot create/apply/dryrun (ETA Tue)
- ophelia: console mockups for preview/diff + confirmation modal (ETA Wed)
- miguel: telemetry + retention design doc (ETA Thu)
- jon: test plan + e2e scenarios (ETA Fri)

deploy-bot: snapshot sn-20250315-0001 created by seema (id=sn-20250315-0001) :white_check_mark:
miguel: :thumbsup:
liam: will start API branch today. thanks.
seema: awesome — we'll sync tomorrow on standup.
